dashboard.description: Operational overview: 30-second signal check, traffic composition, volume trends with baseline, +SIEM outcome signals, and attribution movers. Green = OK, non-green = drill deeper.

options.content:
Bot Insights -- Overview and Alignment
Operational overview: 30-second signal check, traffic composition, volume trends, and SIEM outcomes.
Data Freshness: ${data_freshness}

panels.description: 4xx error rate delta (current window vs baseline). NORMAL < 5pp, ELEVATED 5-12pp, WARNING 12-20pp, CRITICAL > 20pp. Drill: What Changed dashboard.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
  duration AS (
    SELECT greatest(dateDiff('second',
      toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}),
      toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})), 1) AS secs
  ),
  current_rate AS (
    SELECT
      countIfMerge(`countIf(and(greaterOrEquals(toUInt16(response_status_code), 400), less(toUInt16(response_status_code), 500)))`) * 100.0 / greatest(countMerge(`count()`), 1) AS rate
    FROM ${summary_table}
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
      AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
      AND $__adHocFilter()
      AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
      AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
  ),
  baseline_rate AS (
    SELECT
      countIfMerge(`countIf(and(greaterOrEquals(toUInt16(response_status_code), 400), less(toUInt16(response_status_code), 500)))`) * 100.0 / greatest(countMerge(`count()`), 1) AS rate
    FROM ${summary_table}
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) - INTERVAL ${duration} MINUTE
      AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
      AND $__adHocFilter()
      AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
      AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
  )
SELECT
  if((SELECT count() FROM baseline_rate WHERE rate > 0) > 0,
    round((SELECT rate FROM current_rate) - (SELECT rate FROM baseline_rate), 1),
    999) AS value
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Security 4xx rate delta; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Security

panels.description: Good-bot 2xx success rate. NORMAL >= 98%, ELEVATED 95-98%, WARNING 90-95%, CRITICAL < 90%. Drill: Governance dashboard.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfFiveMinutes(timestamp) AS time,
  countIfMerge(`countIf(and(greaterOrEquals(toUInt16(response_status_code), 200), less(toUInt16(response_status_code), 300)))`) * 100.0 / greatest(countMerge(`count()`), 1) AS value
FROM ${summary_table}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
  AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
  AND bot_class IN ('search_bot', 'crawler', 'social_media_agent')
GROUP BY toStartOfFiveMinutes(timestamp)
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Governance good-bot 2xx trend; du=${__user.login}'

panels.description: Cache miss rate delta in percentage points (current vs baseline). NORMAL < 3pp, ELEVATED 3-8pp, WARNING 8-12pp, CRITICAL > 12pp. Drill: Edge/Ops dashboard.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
  duration AS (
    SELECT greatest(dateDiff('second',
      toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}),
      toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})), 1) AS secs
  ),
  current_miss AS (
    SELECT
      countIfMerge(`countIf(equals(cache_was_cached, false))`) * 100.0 / greatest(countIfMerge(`countIf(equals(cache_was_cached, true))`) + countIfMerge(`countIf(equals(cache_was_cached, false))`), 1) AS rate
    FROM ${summary_table}
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
      AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
      AND $__adHocFilter()
      AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
      AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
  ),
  baseline_miss AS (
    SELECT
      countIfMerge(`countIf(equals(cache_was_cached, false))`) * 100.0 / greatest(countIfMerge(`countIf(equals(cache_was_cached, true))`) + countIfMerge(`countIf(equals(cache_was_cached, false))`), 1) AS rate
    FROM ${summary_table}
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) - INTERVAL ${duration} MINUTE
      AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
      AND $__adHocFilter()
      AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
      AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
  )
SELECT
  if((SELECT count() FROM baseline_miss WHERE rate > 0) > 0,
    round((SELECT rate FROM current_miss) - (SELECT rate FROM baseline_miss), 1),
    999) AS value
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Edge miss rate delta; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Edge

panels.description: Combined bot + AI traffic share of total requests. NORMAL < 20%, ELEVATED 20-35%, WARNING 35-50%, CRITICAL > 50%.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
bot_cnt AS (
  SELECT
    toStartOfFiveMinutes(timestamp) AS time,
    countMerge(`count()`) * $scale_factor AS cnt
  FROM ${summary_table}
  WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
    AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
    AND $__adHocFilter()
    AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
    AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
    AND (is_bot_traffic = true OR notEmpty(ai_category))
  GROUP BY toStartOfFiveMinutes(timestamp)
),
total_cnt AS (
  SELECT
    toStartOfFiveMinutes(timestamp) AS time,
    countMerge(`count()`) * $scale_factor AS cnt
  FROM ${summary_table}
  WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
    AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
    AND $__adHocFilter()
    AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
    AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
  GROUP BY toStartOfFiveMinutes(timestamp)
)
SELECT
  t.time,
  ifNull(b.cnt, 0) * 100.0 / greatest(t.cnt, 1) AS value
FROM total_cnt t
LEFT JOIN bot_cnt b ON t.time = b.time
ORDER BY t.time
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Automation share trend; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Automation Micro-Trend

panels.description: Entity with the largest absolute volume delta (current vs baseline). No threshold coloring -- uses fixed #88C9F2.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
  duration AS (
    SELECT greatest(dateDiff('second',
      toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}),
      toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})), 1) AS secs
  ),
  current_window AS (
    SELECT client_asn AS entity, countMerge(`count()`) * $scale_factor AS vol
    FROM ${summary_table}
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
      AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
      AND $__adHocFilter()
      AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
      AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
    GROUP BY client_asn
  ),
  baseline_window AS (
    SELECT client_asn AS entity, countMerge(`count()`) * $scale_factor AS vol
    FROM ${summary_table}
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) - INTERVAL ${duration} MINUTE
      AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
      AND $__adHocFilter()
      AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
      AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
    GROUP BY client_asn
  )
SELECT
  coalesce(c.entity, b.entity) AS asn,
  coalesce(c.entity, b.entity) AS entity,
  'ASN' AS dimension,
  coalesce(c.vol, 0) AS current_vol,
  coalesce(b.vol, 0) AS baseline_vol,
  coalesce(c.vol, 0) - coalesce(b.vol, 0) AS abs_delta,
  if(coalesce(b.vol, 0) > 0, round((coalesce(c.vol, 0) - coalesce(b.vol, 0)) / b.vol * 100, 1), 999) AS delta_pct
FROM current_window AS c
FULL OUTER JOIN baseline_window AS b ON c.entity = b.entity
ORDER BY abs(abs_delta) DESC
LIMIT 1
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top mover name; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Top Mover Delta

panels.description: Host drift indicator. Compares distinct request_host values between current and baseline. STABLE = 0 new hosts, CHANGED = 1+ new hosts.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
  duration AS (
    SELECT greatest(dateDiff('second',
      toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}),
      toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})), 1) AS secs
  ),
  current_hosts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT request_host
    FROM ${summary_table}
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
      AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
      AND $__adHocFilter()
      AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
      AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
  ),
  baseline_hosts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT request_host
    FROM ${summary_table}
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) - INTERVAL ${duration} MINUTE
      AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
      AND $__adHocFilter()
      AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
      AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
  )
SELECT
  countIf(b.request_host IS NULL) AS new_hosts
FROM current_hosts AS c
LEFT JOIN baseline_hosts AS b ON c.request_host = b.request_host
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Host drift; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Collection

panels.description: Traffic composition over time, stacked by classification. Human = is_bot_traffic=0 AND ai_category='', Bot = is_bot_traffic=1 AND ai_category='', AI = ai_category != ''.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time,
  sumIf(vol, traffic_type = 'Human') AS Human,
  sumIf(vol, traffic_type = 'Bot') AS Bot,
  sumIf(vol, traffic_type = 'AI') AS AI
FROM (
  SELECT
    toStartOfFiveMinutes(timestamp) AS time,
    multiIf(
      is_bot_traffic = 0 AND ai_category = '', 'Human',
      is_bot_traffic = 1 AND ai_category = '', 'Bot',
      ai_category != '', 'AI',
      'Other'
    ) AS traffic_type,
    countMerge(`count()`) * $scale_factor AS vol
  FROM ${summary_table}
  WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
    AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
    AND $__adHocFilter()
    AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
    AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
  GROUP BY toStartOfFiveMinutes(timestamp), is_bot_traffic, ai_category
)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
LIMIT 10000
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Human / Bot / AI composition; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Human / Bot / AI

panels.description: Best-available classification breakdown by policy. When classification_policy=akamai_authoritative and SIEM evidence meets threshold, uses Akamai SIEM classification. Otherwise uses UA-derived bot_class.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
  ua_counts AS (
    SELECT class_key, sum(volume) AS volume
    FROM (
      SELECT
        bot_class AS class_key,
        cnt_all AS volume
      FROM ${summary_table}
      WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
        AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
        AND $__adHocFilter()
        AND ('${site}' = '$__all' OR request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}))
      GROUP BY class_key
    )
    GROUP BY class_key
  ),
  siem_counts AS (
    SELECT
      class_key,
      siem_bot_category,
      siem_bot_category_source,
      siem_bot_type,
      sum(volume) AS volume
    FROM (
      SELECT
        akamai_canonical_bot_class AS class_key,
        bot_category AS siem_bot_category,
        bot_category_source AS siem_bot_category_source,
        bot_type AS siem_bot_type,
        cnt_all AS volume
      FROM ${siem_class_summary_table}
      WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
        AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
        AND ('${site}' = '$__all' OR request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}))
        AND notEmpty(bot_category)
      GROUP BY class_key, siem_bot_category, siem_bot_category_source, siem_bot_type
    )
    GROUP BY class_key, siem_bot_category, siem_bot_category_source, siem_bot_type
  ),
  traffic_total AS (
    SELECT sum(total) AS total
    FROM (
      SELECT cnt_all AS total
      FROM ${agg_traffic_table}
      WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
        AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
        AND $__adHocFilter()
        AND ('${site}' = '$__all' OR request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}))
    )
  ),
  siem_evidence AS (
    SELECT
      coalesce(sum(volume), 0) AS siem_event_count,
      coalesce(sum(volume) / nullIf((SELECT total FROM traffic_total), 0), 0) AS siem_coverage_pct
    FROM siem_counts
  ),
  siem_threshold AS (
    SELECT siem_event_count, siem_coverage_pct,
      if(siem_event_count >= 20 OR siem_coverage_pct >= 0.05, 1, 0) AS meets_threshold
    FROM siem_evidence
  ),
  use_siem AS (
    SELECT if(
      '${classification_policy}' = 'akamai_authoritative'
      AND '${has_akamai_siem}' = '1'
      AND (SELECT meets_threshold FROM siem_threshold) = 1,
      1, 0
    ) AS flag
  )
SELECT
  if(canonical_bot_class_source = 'akamai_siem' AND notEmpty(siem_bot_category), siem_bot_category, canonical_bot_class) AS bot_category,
  canonical_bot_class,
  siem_bot_category,
  siem_bot_category_source,
  siem_bot_type,
  canonical_bot_class_source,
  canonical_bot_class_confidence,
  (SELECT siem_event_count FROM siem_threshold) AS siem_event_count,
  (SELECT siem_coverage_pct FROM siem_threshold) AS siem_coverage_pct,
  volume
FROM (
  SELECT
    class_key AS canonical_bot_class,
    '' AS siem_bot_category,
    '' AS siem_bot_category_source,
    '' AS siem_bot_type,
    volume,
    'ua_dict' AS canonical_bot_class_source,
    'derived' AS canonical_bot_class_confidence
  FROM ua_counts WHERE (SELECT flag FROM use_siem) = 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    class_key AS canonical_bot_class,
    siem_bot_category,
    siem_bot_category_source,
    siem_bot_type,
    volume,
    'akamai_siem' AS canonical_bot_class_source,
    'authoritative' AS canonical_bot_class_confidence
  FROM siem_counts WHERE (SELECT flag FROM use_siem) = 1
)
ORDER BY volume DESC
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Composition Breakdown; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Composition Breakdown

panels.description: Hero time series: total request volume with baseline overlay. Current window = solid line. Baseline = dashed line offset to align visually.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
  duration AS (
    SELECT greatest(dateDiff('second',
      toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}),
      toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})) + 1, 1) AS secs
  ),
  current_vol AS (
    SELECT timestamp AS time, countMerge(`count()`) * $scale_factor AS vol
    FROM ${summary_table}
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
      AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
      AND $__adHocFilter()
      AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
      AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
    GROUP BY timestamp
  ),
  baseline_vol AS (
    SELECT timestamp + INTERVAL ${duration} MINUTE AS time, countMerge(`count()`) * $scale_factor AS vol
    FROM ${summary_table}
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) - INTERVAL ${duration} MINUTE
      AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
      AND $__adHocFilter()
      AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
      AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
    GROUP BY timestamp
  )
SELECT
  coalesce(c.time, b.time) AS time,
  c.vol AS Current,
  b.vol AS Baseline
FROM current_vol c
FULL OUTER JOIN baseline_vol b ON c.time = b.time
ORDER BY time
LIMIT 10000
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Request Volume -- Current vs Baseline; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Request Volume -- Current vs Baseline

panels.description: Volume of requests blocked (deny/block action) over time. Sourced from SIEM summary table. Only visible when SIEM data is available.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  countIfMerge(`countIf(or(equals(action_taken, 'deny'), equals(action_taken, 'block')))`) AS Blocked
FROM ${siem_filter_summary_table}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
  AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all' OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND is_bot_traffic = true) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND is_bot_traffic = false) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND notEmpty(ai_category)))
  AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
  AND '${siem_available}' = '1'
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
LIMIT 10000
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Threats Blocked; du=${__user.login}'

list.name: duration
list.query: SELECT greatest(dateDiff('minute', toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}), toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})), 1) AS duration

list.label: Site
list.name: site
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT request_host FROM ${summary_table} WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds}) ORDER BY request_host LIMIT 1000

list.name: siem_available
list.query: SELECT if(countMerge(`count()`) > 0, '1', '0') AS has_siem FROM ${siem_filter_summary_table} WHERE 1=1

list.name: has_akamai_siem
list.query: SELECT if(count() > 0, '1', '0') AS has_siem FROM (SELECT 1 FROM ${siem_class_summary_table} WHERE notEmpty(bot_category) LIMIT 1)

list.name: data_freshness
list.query: SELECT concat(coalesce(hdx_cdn, 'default'), ': ', multiIf(dateDiff('minute', max(timestamp), toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})) < 30, '✅', dateDiff('minute', max(timestamp), toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})) < 120, '⚠️', '🔴'), ' (', toString(dateDiff('minute', max(timestamp), toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds}))), 'm)') FROM ${summary_minute} WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY coalesce(hdx_cdn, 'default') ORDER BY 1

list.label: ASN
